source.name: Denver Nuggets will now play in Ball Arena as part of KSE, Ball Corporation Global Partnership (nba.com, via Wayback Machine)
source.quote: The partnership includes naming rights for Ball and KSE's hometown arena in Denver, Colorado, home to the NBA's Denver Nuggets

note: Arena naming rights: Ball Arena, announced 2020-10-22. The live nba.com page now returns 404; the source is the Wayback Machine capture of 2020-10-24.
